usedFor: Ascora holds quotes, jobs and enquiries, and Hastewire receives their wording to rewrite through “Humanize Text”.

bestTemplate.name: “Quote Created” in Ascora, then “Humanize Text” in Hastewire
bestTemplate.why: A new quote is customer-facing text, and the action makes it sound natural.

watchOut: “Humanize Text” in Hastewire only rewrites text, so a later step must send it, and outside messages wait for approval.
